gui.editor.tip: Opens the bundled KFPS editor — the current plan opens with the source image as a tracing overlay, and the editor's [Export JSON] converts straight back into a plan this window picks up. Without a plan it opens blank; [Import JSON] inside the editor lists every plan under out/ (cel, line, painter). The layer panel's [Split at Line] cuts the selected layers or group into two groups at one line.
gui.export.fls.tip: The project ForzaLiveryStudio opens. The container the game reads lives under [Apply in game].
gui.export.fs.tip: Our own design format. Load it again and this window reads it directly.

gui.export.kfps.tip: The JSON the KFPS editor and importer read. Written, read back and rendered for comparison; the difference goes to the log.
gui.export.none: Nothing selected — pick at least one format.
gui.export.tip: Write the FLS, KFPS and FS formats to a folder of your choosing, in one go.

gui.fls.editor.tip: Opens the design in the bundled FLS editor - a native editor that drags shapes around and previews the livery on the car in 3D. In a livery project its Itasha menu composes a whole itasha: load a design, auto-place, decoration, mirror, base paint, export. Edit > Split Selection at a Line cuts the selected layers or group into two groups at one line.

gui.fls.missing:
The FLS editor is not here.

[Yes] download it (about 31 MB) — **our build, with the Itasha menu**. The corresponding source AGPL requires ships in the same release. If that is unavailable it falls back to the upstream official release (no Itasha menu).
[Open] pick a ForzaLiveryStudio.exe you already have

Note: saving files works without the editor — the game reads files, not editors.

gui.route.cel.hint: Reinterprets the art as cel-anime flats and strokes, the way human livery artists work. The picture decides the layer count — a layer is placed only if it earns its keep. Usually 1,000~2,000, which halves the in-game setup.
gui.route.cel.tip: The default route. Matches how human artists spend layers in the reference videos (185~2,014), placing what pays rather than filling a budget.
gui.route.line.hint: Traces only the line art — no fills, so the design lays bare lines over the car paint. The same method humans use with a translucent overlay of the original, tracing lines one by one. The picture decides the layer count.
gui.route.line.tip: Places the neural line art (AniLines) as curve and bar strokes. Colors are sampled from the original — brown hair lines stay brown.
gui.route.painter.hint: Same logic as KFPS (kloudys-forza-painter-suite) — GPU raw build plus checkpoint finalize. Minutes for 3,000 layers. Scored on the A_02 48-gon and the in-game input-step grid.
gui.route.painter.need_shapes: Painter needs a layer count before it can make a plan (1~3,000).
